task.ques: For Non-English submissions, do I need to provide a multi-language abstract, if need, answer the separator between the multiple abstracts.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: No multilingual abstract or separator is specified in arXiv’s current guidance. For a non-English submission, you must provide a full English version of the paper, placed first; an English abstract alone is insufficient. The full-English-version policy took effect February 11, 2026.
Evidence: “Non-English submissions,” https://info.arxiv.org/help/faq/multilang.html ; “Abstract: required,” https://info.arxiv.org/help/prep.html#abstract-required ; policy effective date, https://blog.arxiv.org/2026/01/13/non-english-paper-submission-guidelines/ . Screenshot: final.png.
